source: RFC-0007 Appendix B section 2 (wording verbatim; a cell mixing a quoted message and a hint is split into message and remediation; rows with no Carter message use the observed string)

errors.message: The LLM signing key isn't loaded. Nothing was committed; your changes are still staged. Run `carter identity unlock` in your own terminal, then ask me to retry.
errors.remediation: A password-manager variant says "approve the signing request in <app>".

errors.message: The LLM signing key isn't loaded. Nothing was committed; your changes are still staged. Run `carter identity unlock` in your own terminal, then ask me to retry.
errors.remediation: Same; `unlock` restarts a stale agent.

errors.message: Key locked. Unlock now? [y/N]
errors.remediation: On no/failure: "Committed **unsigned** with `Co-authored-by: LLM`; it shows Unverified while the LLM account has vigilant mode on (Partially verified if you sign it yourself)."

errors.message: No LLM signing key (T1): committed unsigned with `Co-authored-by: LLM`.
Refusing: key locked and this is an agent shell [D36]. Changes left staged.
Signing refused: only the configured LLM key via the agent may sign (no `-S<key>`).
OpenSSH too old for `SSH_ASKPASS_REQUIRE`; upgrade.
Carter isolation file is missing, invalid, or doesn't match its install-time hash; agent shells are disabled. Run `carter guard install` in your terminal.
The LLM signing identity is unavailable (<reason>); agent commits are blocked, not downgraded. Changes are still staged. Run `carter check --host`.
Carter plugin self-test failed on OpenCode <v>: all shells are treated as agent shells and B is disabled. See `carter check --host`.
carter-guard: agent commits need the Carter identity block (plugin not loaded?).
errors.remediation: Check the plugin is loaded (`carter check --host`); restart OpenCode; no per-command fallback.

errors.message: carter-guard: commit rejected: committer is <x>, expected <y>
errors.remediation: Remove `GIT_COMMITTER_*` overrides; re-run `carter identity add` if `carter.llmEmail` is stale.

errors.message: commit.gpgsign is not true / gpg.format is not ssh / user.signingkey is not a key:: literal / gpg.ssh.program is not the Carter shim
errors.remediation: Don't pass `-c` signing overrides (forbidden list).

errors.message: Co-authored-by trailer missing
errors.remediation: `prepare-commit-msg` adds it; re-run without editing it out.

errors.message: Signing attempted below T2: agent commits here are unsigned [D51]. Don't pass `-S` or override `commit.gpgsign`. If you just changed `max_tier`, run `carter update`.
carter-guard(post-commit): HEAD <sha> is unsigned or not signed by the LLM key
errors.remediation: Warning, never undone; re-commit without `--no-gpg-sign`; A+/B will refuse the push otherwise.

errors.message: carter-guard: agent push blocked (<reason>)
errors.remediation: Pushes are human-only: write the handoff and tell the user: Run `carter push` and then `carter pr` in your own terminal, not through an agent.

errors.message: fatal: 'no_push' does not appear to be a git repository
errors.remediation: Same: pushes are human-only.

errors.message: permission.rejected: Blocked by configuration policy
errors.remediation: Same; for gh, use an allowlisted read verb: `gh pr|issue|run <verb> -R <owner>/<repo>` (put `-R` after the subcommand), and `gh repo view <owner>/<repo>` or `gh search repos <query>` positionally, with no `-R`.

errors.message: `<verb>` is human-only (rule `<id>`). Hand off: ask the human to run `carter push` / `carter pr` in their own terminal.
errors.remediation: Commands shown without a leading `!`.

errors.message: Command gate unavailable; command refused (fail closed). Run `carter check --host`.

errors.where: gh or git write with the read-only PAT
errors.message: GitHub refused the write: the read-only token has no write access (`Resource not accessible by personal access token`, HTTP 403).
errors.remediation: Writes are human-only. Run `carter push` and then `carter pr` in your own terminal, not through an agent.
observed: fatal: unable to access 'https://github.com/<o>/<r>.git/': The requested URL returned error: 403
gh: Resource not accessible by personal access token (HTTP 403)

errors.message: Only fine-grained `github_pat_` tokens are accepted (what was found is named by its type or at most a 4-character prefix, never quoted).
errors.remediation: Create a read-only fine-grained token on the repositories Carter works on, then pipe it to `carter github-token set` in your own terminal.

errors.message: Token file must be 0600, yours, not a symlink, outside any repo.
errors.remediation: Fix the mode or location (the secrets directory must be 0700), or run `carter github-token set` again.

errors.message: Permission denied (publickey).
errors.remediation: Expected; agent fetch uses HTTPS + PAT.

errors.message: `carter_push` is devops-only.
carter_push refused: approval arrived in <n>ms (< <min>ms), looks like client auto-accept
errors.remediation: Disable autoaccept / `--auto`; approve manually.

errors.message: No approval within 120 s; refused.
errors.remediation: Use A+.

errors.message: permission requested: carter_push (…); auto-rejecting
errors.remediation: B needs an interactive approver (C8); use A+.

errors.message: The OpenCode server env contains agent/human signals or Carter isolation values (`<names>`); restart it from a clean terminal (see `carter check --host`).
Config, hooks or SSH config at scope `<scope>` (`<key>`) could run code with your credentials; use `carter push` and review.
Your SSH agent socket in the OpenCode server env is stale or not yours; restart OpenCode or use `carter push`.
`origin` is HTTPS; B pushes over SSH only. Use `carter push`.
HEAD moved after approval (`<pinned>` → `<now>`); refused.
Commits `<shas>` have the LLM as committer but no valid LLM signature; refused.
`<branch>` is the remote default branch; B never pushes it. Run `carter push` in your own terminal (typed confirmation).
Only fast-forward of the current non-default branch to `origin` is allowed.
B refused: 3 rejections in this session family. Start a new session or run `carter guard status --reset-b`.
PR text matches a secret pattern (`<rule>`); refused.
No valid handoff at `.carter/state/handoff/<branch>.md`, or `head_sha` is not an ancestor of HEAD.
unlock needs a terminal for the passphrase; run it in your own terminal.
Refusing inside OpenCode (agent shell or integrated terminal); run it in your own terminal.
Key has no passphrase: any process of your user could sign as `<llm-login>` without unlock or TTL. Pass `--allow-no-passphrase` to accept the risk.
unix_listener: cannot bind to path <sock>: Address already in use
errors.remediation: Carter removes a stale **socket** under lock; refuses a non-socket, symlink or foreign-owned path; length hint (macOS 104, Linux 108 bytes).

errors.message: Bad passphrase, try again for <key>:
errors.remediation: Passed through from ssh-add.

errors.where: `identity add` (added beyond Appendix B, plan 005 H16)
errors.message: The identity failed a check (<reason>): not a signing key, registered as an authentication key, your own key, an id or type mismatch, or a private key. Nothing was written.
errors.remediation: Fix the input and run `carter identity add` again.

errors.where: `identity add`, `identity verify --remote` (added beyond Appendix B, plan 005 H16)
errors.message: GitHub could not be reached or answered with an error (<detail>: network, server error or rate limit). Nothing was written.
errors.remediation: Try again later; these checks send no token.

errors.message: config.toml is invalid; agent commits are disabled until fixed.
errors.remediation: Never falls back to defaults.

errors.message: Role `author` needs a signing key; refusing (no downgrade).
This workspace caps the tier at `<t>` (`max_tier`): agent commits are unsigned human/human with the `<t>` trailer.
errors.remediation: A stale mirror in either direction rejects the agent commit with "run `carter update`".

errors.where: plugin (agent commit blocked) / `carter commit`, below the pinned `require_tier`
errors.message: This workspace requires tier `<t>`; configure the LLM identity.
Policy `<statement>` not loaded — a broken OpenCode config drops all of them and your providers.

errors.where: `carter push` (added beyond Appendix B, plan 003 step 6 F10)
errors.message: `carter push` pushes only the current branch to `origin`: no detached HEAD, no other remote.
errors.remediation: Check out the branch you want to push; there are no flags for force, tags or other remotes.

errors.where: `carter guard install|remove`, `github-token set|check`, `push`, `pr` (added beyond Appendix B, plan 003 step 6 F10)
errors.message: This command runs only in your own terminal: this shell looks like an agent's, or it has no TTY. If you are not an agent, this shell inherited agent variables; restart the app from a clean terminal.
errors.remediation: Open a terminal that OpenCode did not start and run the command there.

errors.where: `carter guard *` (added beyond Appendix B, plan 003 step 6 F10)
errors.message: ~/.carter/guard-state.json is unreadable or from a newer Carter; nothing was changed.
errors.remediation: Run `carter guard status` to see the problem; fix or move the file yourself. Carter never rebuilds it.

errors.message: G2 untested on OpenCode <v>; relying on the plugin self-test.
errors.remediation: < 2.1: hard fail; 2.1.0–2.1.3 or above tested: warn.

errors.message: Global guards need git ≥ 2.54 (`brew upgrade git`); per-repo hooks offered. LLM signing (T2) needs git ≥ 2.40 (`-U` for `key::` literals).
errors.remediation: Unguarded repo while T2 is set: FAIL in `check --host`. Below 2.40 `carter identity add` refuses and writes nothing.

errors.where: `carter check --probe` (added beyond Appendix B, plan 004 step 8 G14)
errors.message: `carter check --probe` runs only inside an agent shell: ask your agent to run it.
errors.remediation: `E-HUMAN-TERMINAL` means the opposite (a human-only command run by an agent), so it is not reused.

errors.where: `carter guard install` (added beyond Appendix B, plan 004 step 8 G14; RFC C.2.1)
errors.message: no root-owned `false` found at /usr/bin/false or /bin/false; G2 cannot be installed
errors.remediation: Nothing was written. The isolation block needs a `false` that the user cannot modify (never one found through the command search path).
